original.title: Stress, Appraisal, and Coping
original.note: Book checked in Open Library (/works/OL1841147W, first published 1984). ISBN is one edition's; cite the edition you read.

core_idea: Stress depends on how a person appraises a situation (is it a threat?) and their resources to cope. Coping can focus on solving the problem or managing the emotion.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How do students, workers or patients experience and cope with stress?
Which coping strategies relate to well-being?
Typical data: surveys (e.g. Ways of Coping, Brief COPE), interviews, diaries.
common_mistakes: Treating stress as only the event or only the response.
Labelling coping strategies as always good or bad.
Measuring coping once when it is a process.
